comment: Frame 209: the back of the German title page (frame 210): the imprint of the printer of the text and of the plates.
observations: The imprint stands in the middle of the page, in small Roman capitals: the text was printed (letterpress) by Adolf Holzhausen, university printer in Vienna, VII., Kandlgasse 19-21, and the plates (collotype) by Max Jaffé, Vienna, XVII., Leopold-Ernst-Gasse 36. «LICHTDRUCK VON MAX JAFFÉ» is letter-spaced. The figures of «19—21» are old-style. The title page of frame 210 shows through faintly from the other side of the leaf.

The German front matter is bound at the end of the volume, which opens from the right: the title leaves (frames 209-214) and the introduction (frames 182-208) are read from frame 214 back to frame 182. The Arabic title page of 1926 is frame 007.
